data.name: ManagedLaunchUnsupported
data.value: Managed startup ANR protection requires Android 12 or later and a force-stopped activity launch on a single-user device. Launching without changing the device debug-app setting.

data.name: ManagedLaunchPackageMismatch

data.name: ManagedLaunchComponentUnsupported

data.name: ManagedLaunchLayoutUnsupported

data.name: ManagedLaunchGateTimeout

data.name: ManagedLaunchProcessUnsupported

data.name: ManagedLaunchStateConflict
